claim: Stone is scarce in the Wetlands: the only source is Ruins, which you recycle for Stone.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report in the wiki session, 20 November 2026.

notes: The version 31 files store 10 Stone for recycling one Ruins, and list 4 Ruins at the start of Copies and 7 at the start of Chaos. They also put a Stone Mine on Clause's build list; whether Clause has rocks to mine has not been checked.
